en.label: Relay — Five Decisions
en.question: What is Relay?
en.answer: Relay is one of Diego's Five Decisions, currently planned rather than started. Its guiding question hasn't been set yet — it publishes here the day work on Relay actually begins.

es.label: Relay — Five Decisions
es.question: ¿Qué es Relay?
es.answer: Relay es una de las Five Decisions de Diego, todavía planificada y sin empezar. Su pregunta guía aún no se ha definido — se publicará aquí el día que el trabajo realmente comience.
